rounds.prompt: The manager wanted to know whether I was available to assist.

options.text: The manager asked me to help.
The manager told me to help.
The manager asked me if I could help.

rounds.explanation: «Asked me if» solicita información sobre disponibilidad; «asked me to» pediría la acción.

rounds.prompt: “Can you swim?” she asked me.

options.text: She asked could I swim.
She asked me to swim.
She asked me if I could swim.

rounds.explanation: Pregunta por capacidad, por eso usa «asked if», no «asked to».

rounds.prompt: “Don't touch the switch,” she told me. She told me [gap1].

options.text: if I didn't touch the switch
not to touch the switch
don't touch the switch

rounds.explanation: La orden negativa usa «not to + infinitivo».

rounds.prompt: “Could you open the window, please?” Sara said to Leo.

options.text: Sara asked Leo if he could open the window.
Sara asked Leo to open the window.
Sara asked to Leo opening the window.

rounds.explanation: En contexto, «Could you ... please?» es una petición de acción.

rounds.prompt: “Who called you?” Eva asked me.

options.text: Eva asked who had I called.
Eva told me who called you?
Eva asked who had called me.

rounds.explanation: «Who» ya es sujeto; no añadimos «did» ni invertimos.

rounds.prompt: “Wait outside,” the guard said to us. The guard [gap1] outside.

options.text: told to us wait
told us to wait
said us to wait

rounds.explanation: Una instrucción usa «told + persona + to + infinitivo».

rounds.prompt: The manager wanted me to perform the action.

options.text: The manager asked me if I could help.
The manager asked me to help.
The manager asked if to help.

rounds.explanation: «Asked me to help» es una petición de acción.

rounds.prompt: “Keep the receipt,” the assistant said to me.

options.text: The assistant told to keep me the receipt.
The assistant told me to keep the receipt.
The assistant said me to keep the receipt.

rounds.explanation: La instrucción usa «told me to keep».

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.

activities.instructions: Colócate en el carril de la respuesta correcta antes de cruzar cada puerta.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: “Is the shop open?” He asked [gap1] the shop was open.

options.text: if
what
to

rounds.explanation: Una pregunta sí/no se introduce con «if» o «whether».

rounds.prompt: “Please help me,” Maya said to Leo. Maya [gap1].

options.text: asked Leo to help her
said Leo to help me
told Leo if he helped her

rounds.explanation: Una petición usa «asked + persona + to» y adapta el pronombre.

rounds.prompt: “Do you need a receipt?” the cashier asked me.

options.text: The cashier asked me did I need a receipt.
The cashier asked me if I needed a receipt.
The cashier asked that I need a receipt.

rounds.explanation: Se elimina «do» y se usa orden afirmativo tras «if».

rounds.prompt: “Is the fee refundable?” the customer asked.

options.text: The customer asked whether was or not the fee refundable.
The customer told if the fee had refundable or not.
The customer asked whether or not the fee was refundable.

rounds.explanation: «Whether or not» va seguido de orden afirmativo.

rounds.prompt: “When did the meeting start?” they asked.

options.text: They asked when did the meeting start.
They told when had the meeting started.
They asked when the meeting had started.

rounds.explanation: Se elimina «did», se usa orden afirmativo y past perfect.

rounds.prompt: “Don't block the entrance,” the marshal told the drivers.

options.text: The marshal asked if the drivers didn't block the entrance.
The marshal said the drivers to not blocked the entrance.
The marshal told the drivers not to block the entrance.

rounds.explanation: La instrucción negativa usa «told + objeto + not to».

rounds.prompt: On Monday Rina asked Leo, “Can you bring these folders here tomorrow?”

options.text: Rina asked Leo if he could bring these folders here tomorrow.
Rina told Leo whether he can brought those folders there.
Rina asked Leo to bring those folders there the next day.

rounds.explanation: La forma cortés solicita una acción y cambian demostrativo, lugar y tiempo.

rounds.prompt: “Has the parcel arrived?” Jo asked.

options.text: Jo told if the parcel has arrived.
Jo asked whether the parcel had arrived.
Jo asked whether had the parcel arrived.

rounds.explanation: Present perfect retrocede a past perfect tras «whether».

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.

activities.instructions: Apila los fragmentos en orden para levantar la frase.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: First Ana said, “Can you drive?” Then she said, “Could you drive me home, please?”

options.text: Ana told me whether I drove, then asked me if to drive her home.
Ana asked me if I could drive, then asked me to drive her home.
Ana asked me to drive, then asked if I could drive her home.

rounds.explanation: La primera frase pregunta capacidad; la segunda solicita una acción.

rounds.prompt: “Why is the gate locked?” Nina asked.

options.text: Nina asked why was the gate locked.
Nina asked why the gate was locked.
Nina told why the gate is locked.

rounds.explanation: Se conserva «why», se usa orden afirmativo y se aplica backshift.

rounds.prompt: “Where did you put these keys?” Amir asked Lena.

options.text: Amir asked Lena where did she put these keys.
Amir asked if where Lena had put this keys.
Amir asked Lena where she had put those keys.

rounds.explanation: Se eliminan «did» e inversión y cambian pronombre, tiempo y demostrativo.

rounds.prompt: “Will you be here tomorrow?” Nina asked Omar.

options.text: Nina asked Omar whether he would be there the next day.
Nina asked Omar will he be here tomorrow.
Nina asked whether would Omar be here the day before.

rounds.explanation: Cambian orden, «will», pronombre, lugar y tiempo.

rounds.prompt: The guide said, “Stay together, and don't cross the rope.”

options.text: The guide said us to stay and not cross the rope.
The guide told to us stay together and don't crossing the rope.
The guide told us to stay together and not to cross the rope.

rounds.explanation: Las instrucciones afirmativa y negativa comparten «told us».

rounds.prompt: “Please don't mention my address,” Maya said to me.

options.text: Maya said me not mention her address.
Maya asked me not to mention her address.
Maya told me if I didn't mention my address.

rounds.explanation: La petición negativa usa «asked me not to» y cambia el posesivo.

rounds.prompt: “Where is the station?” She asked [gap1].

options.text: where was the station
where the station was
where the station is?

rounds.explanation: La pregunta reportada usa orden afirmativo.

rounds.prompt: “Why haven't you sent me the revised figures?” Nora asked Sam.

options.text: Nora asked Sam why hadn't he sent me the revised figures.
Nora asked Sam why he hadn't sent her the revised figures.
Nora asked if why Sam didn't sent her the figures.

rounds.explanation: Se usa orden afirmativo, past perfect y pronombres adaptados.
